name: 阿梨

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat muted colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, at most one small lit accent. Full body, strict side view facing right, the whole figure from the top of the head to the soles inside the frame, tall in the frame: the figure fills nine tenths of the picture height. The character stands upright and still, like a model sheet: weight evenly on both feet, hips and shoulders level, the spine vertical, the chest not pushed out and the lower back not arched, the head level. The near arm hangs straight down beside the thigh with an open empty hand; it is not swept back. The far arm is hidden behind the torso. The feet are a small step apart with the far foot half a step ahead, so the far shin and the far shoe show in front of the near leg. Ali, a woman of twenty-seven who works the night shift at a harbour clinic lounge and wants to open a noodle stall; clearly a young woman, about seven heads tall, slight build. Chin-length dark brown hair tucked behind the ear with one plain green clip, tired kind eyes with faint shadows under them, a small closed-mouth smile. She wears a washed-out pale teal short-sleeved work tunic with a pen in the breast pocket; a short dark waist apron that ends at mid-thigh, with an old stain and a folded dish towel tucked into its string; plain grey trousers worn thin at the knee; old cream canvas sneakers with grey laces. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles where the cloth bends, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face. Few large plain shapes, no decorative details beyond the ones described. Even overcast light, no glow, no bloom, no text.
